ontrolSocket(epoch,socket)
278:                     }
279:                     override fun onFailure(socket:WebSocket,t:Throwable,response:Response?) {
280:                         if(retireControlSocket(epoch,socket)) Log.e("MeshCentralClient","Control socket failed (${t.javaClass.simpleName})")
281:                     }
282:                 })
283:                 val socket=webSocket!!
284:                 controlTimeout=scope.launch {
285:                     delay(20_000L)
286:                     controlGeneration.runIfCurrent(epoch) {
287:                         if(webSocket===socket && controlConnecting && !isUserLogout) {
288:                             retireControlSocket(epoch,socket)
289:                             socket.cancel()
290:                         }
291:                     }
292:                 }
293:             } catch(_:IllegalArgumentException) {
294:                 controlConfigValid=false
295:                 controlGeneration.advance()
296:                 controlConnecting=false
297:                 webSocket=null
298:                 _connectionState.value=false
299:                 _connectionStatus.value=ConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED
300:                 Log.e("MeshCentralClient","Invalid control connection configuration")
301:             }
302:         }
303:     }
304: 
305:     fun requestServerData() {
306:         webSocket?.send("""{"action":"userinfo"}""")
307:         webSocket?.send("""{"action":"meshes"}""")
308:         webSocket?.send("""{"action":"nodes"}""")
309:         webSocket?.send("""{"action":"authcookie"}""")
310:     }
311: 
312:     fun requestTunnel(nodeId:String,protocol:Int,tunnelId:String) {
313:         val captured=webSocket ?: return
314:         scope.launch {
315:             if(relayAuthCookie.isEmpty()) {
316:                 captured.send(JsonObject().apply { addProperty("action","authcookie") }.toString())
317:                 delay(150)
318:             }
319:             controlGeneration.locked {
320:                 if(webSocket!==captured || isUserLogout || !_connectionState.value) return@locked
321:                 val fullNodeId="node//"+nodeId.removePrefix("node//").removePrefix("node/").trim()
322:                 val encodedId=URLEncoder.encode(fullNodeId,"UTF-8")
323:                 val token=URLEncoder.encode(relayAuthCookie.ifEmpty { extractRawToken(authCookie) },"UTF-8")
324:                 val packet=JsonObject().apply {
325:                     addProperty("action","msg")
326:                     addProperty("type","tunnel")
327:                     addProperty("nodeid",fullNodeId)
328:                     addProperty("value","*/meshrelay.ashx?p=$protocol&nodeid=$encodedId&id=$tunnelId&rauth=$token&auth=$token")
329:                     addProperty("usage",protocol)
330:                     addProperty("rights",0xFFFFFFFF.toInt())
331:                 }
332:                 captured.send(packet.toString())
333:             }
334:         }
335:     }
336: 
337:     fun sendTerminalResize(nodeId: String, cols: Int, rows: Int) {
338:         if (cols < 5 || rows < 2) return
339:         val fullNodeId = if (!nodeId.startsWith("node//")) "node//" + nodeId.removePrefix("node/") else nodeId
340: 
341:         val msg1 = JsonObject().apply {
342:             addProperty("action", "msg")
343:             addProperty("type", "termsize")
344:             addProperty("nodeid", fullNodeId)
345:             addProperty("cols", cols)
346:             addProperty("rows", rows)
347:         }
348:         webSocket?.send(msg1.toString())
349: 
350:         val msg2 = JsonObject().apply {
351:             addProperty("action", "termsize")
352:             addProperty("nodeid", fullNodeId)
353:             addProperty("cols", cols)
354:             addProperty("rows", rows)
355:         }
356:         webSocket?.send(msg2.toString())
357: 
358:         Log.d("MeshCentralClient", "Sent PTY termsize to control socket: cols=$cols, rows=$rows")
359:     }
360: 
361:     private fun handleControlMessage(text: String) {
362:         try {
363:             val json = gson.fromJson(text, JsonObject::class.java) ?: return
364:             val action = json.get("action")?.asString ?: return
365: 
366: 
367:             when (action) {
368:                 "serverinfo", "userinfo", "authcookie" -> {
369:                     if (action == "authcookie") {
370:                         val cookieVal = json.get("cookie")?.asString ?: ""
371:
